# Generated by the Niobium FHE Application Design AI Assistant (FHEanna).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(rescrubbed CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

# Pulls in the instrumented OpenFHE, libnbfhetch and the probe hooks in one go.
find_package(NiobiumFhetch REQUIRED)

add_library(rescrubbed_common STATIC app/rescrubbed.cpp)
target_include_directories(rescrubbed_common PUBLIC app)
target_link_libraries(rescrubbed_common PUBLIC Niobium::niobium_fhetch)

foreach(prog keygen encrypt decrypt)
  add_executable(rescrubbed_${prog} app/${prog}.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(rescrubbed_${prog} PRIVATE rescrubbed_common)
endforeach()

# Only the server is instrumented: it is the part that runs on the vendor's
# machine and, later, on the Fog.
add_executable(rescrubbed_server app/server.cpp)
target_link_libraries(rescrubbed_server PRIVATE rescrubbed_common)
target_compile_definitions(rescrubbed_server PRIVATE NIOBIUM_COMPILER)
